actual.head: 41-fix-measure-command-workflow

actual.description: Synthetic advisory description for the benchmark; no real vulnerability.

commands.other_workflow_steps: Build a replacement plan from exact returned text and SHA before applying it.
Perform one controlled fixture mutation between initializing the baseline and the two observations.
Only the first file’s first count correction is authorized; preserve the input spec.

limitations: Representative scenarios, not every option or error path.
Some workflows intentionally contain multiple CLI calls; functional success is not proof of one-call or token savings.
Model input cache and real context return after unrelated work were not measured.
No live GitHub latency, macOS runtime, or Windows runtime measurement.
This is a normalized summary; reproduce raw responses and state traces with the documented preflight runners.
